integrity: Analytical area and support arguments constitute the proof. Exact finite rational checks and quadrature corroborate rather than prove the asymptotics. No independent assessment has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Square lattice only, disk radius just above \(1/\sqrt2\) and below one; asymptotic statements are as epsilon decreases to zero. An earlier exact marginal area law is explicitly credited and not claimed as new. Full text of a historically plausible 2006 digitization paper was inaccessible; unindexed older coverage is possible.
title: Two-scale conditional localization at the first random lattice-disk coverage transition
